description: Whole-sequence analysis (translate/ORF/enzymes) / 序列综合分析（翻译/ORF/酶切/质粒图 一次出） | USE WHEN: the user pastes a nucleotide sequence and wants six-frame translation, ORFs, restriction sites (and optionally a plasmid map) in one call | ALIASES: 序列分析, 综合分析, 六框翻译, ORF, 酶切位点, 质粒, sequence analysis, six-frame, translation, restriction sites | RETURNS: length、六框 translation、orfs（含起止与氨基酸数）、酶切位点、可选质粒图坐标；超长序列返回 {async:true, task_id} 而非结果

orf_min_aa.description: ORF 最小氨基酸数，0 = 不过滤

run_plasmid.description: 是否生成质粒图谱坐标，默认 false

run_translation.description: 是否做六框翻译，默认 true
